title: arachnis evrardii
intro: Arachnis evrardii, commonly known as Queen of the Night, is a type of flowering vine native to tropical Asia, particularly in the Philippines. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, and therapeutic actions like reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been found to possess antioxidant and antispasmodic activities. Research on Arachnis evrardii has also identified its potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, due to its cytotoxic and antitumor properties.
